counter_design.representation: Reuse the existing readiness word: zero means inactive, otherwise it stores remaining traversals plus one. Both original balance homes and all frame offsets remain unchanged.
counter_design.entry: N=min(C/c,P/p), ignoring zero comparison price; eligibility requires c>1, which proves N+1 fits u64 for every finite u64 balance.
counter_design.header: At the original header, encoded readiness above one admits a traversal and decrements once. The final active value one denotes an exhausted loan.
counter_design.settlement: Recompute initial N from the unchanged original pair; t=N-(encoded-1). Restore C-t*c and P-t*p to their original homes before the unchanged end callback and clear readiness.
counter_design.wire: Preserve all three homes, callback arguments, runtime reconciliation and checkpoint clearance. IR85 separates the new private encoding; ABI29 and work policy68 remain.
counter_design.qualification: Differential compiled-source tests across original/decoded artifacts, repeated prefixes, Unicode/CRLF, source errors and exact/one-short independent finite budget dimensions.

promotion: No diagnostic-only reduction, static instruction change, or interval including zero establishes a runtime improvement.
current_experiment_status: Counter is correct but unpromoted: paired +2.18% and +1.82%; scanner 0.07377 versus 0.07396 seconds. Production and diagnostic source committed; evidence verified.
